goal: Inspect up to four primary sources on practical agent-memory systems or methods. For each, record the canonical HTTPS link, exact sections inspected, storage model, write/update policy, retrieval method, forgetting or contradiction handling, comparison baseline, budget comparability, and author-reported evidence. Separate author claims from inference and note limitations. Record every search query and outcome, then stop using a stated auditable rule (for example, four eligible sources or exhaustion of a narrowly defined query set). Research and documentation only: no installation, code execution, implementation, or result reproduction.

instances.summary: Advance one bounded research loop to audit practical memory evidence against simple baselines.
